nom: COSRX PDRN Exosome Skinplaning Glaze Mask with Collagen & Peptide

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports a mattifying effect while skin still felt moisturized, and another with combination-oily skin describes a light dewy glow with no irritation.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dry-leaning skin report the mask left skin hydrated and soft, though one non-dry reviewer warns those who lean dry to seal in moisture with a heavier cream or oil afterward.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (including combo-oily and combo-dry variants) consistently report hydration, smoothness and glow, with no breakouts mentioned.
segments.sensitive: Most self-described sensitive-skin reviewers report no irritation or burning and note softness and glow, but one reviewer reports breaking out in hives all over the face for hours after use.
segments.mature: Reviewers identifying as aging, mature or older (39, 66 years old) report firmer, plumper skin, fewer visible lines, and a brighter, more youthful look.
segments.normal: One reviewer without particular skin problems still reports a visibly improved, smoother look with less need for makeup.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on aging report firmer, plumper skin and fewer visible fine lines and wrinkles after use, including a 66-year-old reviewer noting a younger look despite sun damage.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers report increased hydration, plumpness and reduced need for extra moisturizer layers; one reviewer expecting dryness after a peel-off mask was surprised to find skin glowing and not dehydrated.
concerns.redness: One reviewer used the mask to cover redness/rosacea with makeup afterward, but the mask itself is not reported to reduce redness directly; the same reviewer reports strong coverage results.
concerns.barrier: A couple of reviewers highlight that the product paired well with barrier-supporting routines (ceramide moisturizer, hyaluronic acid) and did not compromise the skin barrier, feeling soothing rather than stripping.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the mask helped clear an unusual breakout, and another notes it helped with a minor acne breakout without irritation.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer states the mask helps heal and take care of blemishes; another reports no new breakouts despite waiting to check after each use, though results here are anecdotal and limited.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report a mattifying finish and reduced buildup/oil residue after use, with skin still feeling moisturized rather than stripped.

aspects.libelle: Thick, sticky, glue-like texture before drying
Long dry time (30+ minutes to overnight)
Generous amount of product per packet

extraits.texte: I applied this mask earlier today and as I was taking it off I noticed my face immediately broke into hives , It did do its job of leaving skin Glowing but I cant see myself using this Peel off ever again, Its been 4 hours and Im still breaking out in Hives all over my face.

extraits.titre: sticky mess, hard to peel off
extraits.texte: I had such high hopes for this, I love CosRX. It has a thick slimy gel texture. hard to apply, you need to use a lot of product. takes at least 30 mins to dry Then the product doesnt peel off in sheets like other peel off masks i am used to. i had to roll it off in small motions, took a while. Still had patches of it stuck on, so then I rinsed the residue off. that is a LOT OF WORK. and my skin felt a little tight, not moisturized at all. Back it goes

Although product is a cream, it dries like gel. First time user, thank you for the sample. The application is easy and glides on very well, drying time was on point and film peeled off easily. During and after pictures attached, so far love the after effect which is matting (I do have oily skin), yet skin looks and feel moisturized. Will share more finding with additional use.

I have aging, combo skin that is also annoyingly sensitive, and I have to say that this was just what it needed! After using, my skin had more moisture and looked plumper and refreshed. It was very easy to use and I appreciated the little tool they provide to minimize contamination. Highly recommend!

extraits.titre: I would buy a gallon of this if I could
extraits.texte: I am 39 years old. I have combination skin that leans to the oily side. I tried to smash for the first time the other night. I left it on for an hour and peeled it off. Because I can't sleep with things on my face. That night, my skin had a light Dewey glow to it, which was beautiful. I went ahead with my normal hyaluronic acid, cosrx moisturizer. In the morning, I rinse my face off before the gym and the whole day. It still had this beautiful Dewey glow and the texture was so smooth. My skin is pretty smooth anyway with a bump here or there. But I am in love with this mask as I have been in love with all of cosrx products for a long time now I will absolutely be a frequent buyer of this if I could buy a gallon of it, I would. I don't have problematic skin, but this made it look so beautiful and I needed it way less make up.

I received the COSRX PDRN EXOSOME Skinplaning Glaze Mask for a free trial. I've used the product only three times. But since the first use, I surprisingly saw a difference. I have sensitive, combination skin and this did not irritate, clog my pores, or have any other diverse effects. I used it as an over night mask and peeled it off in the morning.

I just used this absolutely wonderful product for the first time. After one use, my skin is not only glowing, but it looks younger!!! At 66 with sun damage, I'll take that! This will most likely be another one of my forever products!
